description: Open source repository of plugins primarily intended for knowledge workers to use in Claude Cowork
summary: The plugin format is just a folder of markdown skills, a JSON manifest, and an MCP config — no build step, no runtime, no infrastructure — which is the kind of inspectable, composable agent configuration I want to see as the default instead of another proprietary SDK. The bio-research plugin is the one that actually pulled me in: it wires Claude to PubMed, ChEMBL, Open Targets, and Benchling, the preclinical pipeline I grew up in, and the skill files show how to encode workflows like target prioritization without writing a line of glue code. For someone juggling agent sessions the way I do with PenguPool and AgentOn Pocket, the fact that every connector is a single MCP server entry in a JSON file means I could fork this structure and point it at my own local tools without touching a dashboard or signing up for Cowork.
